WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN as_of
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
  AND o.completed_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_completed
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'

SELECT AVG(net_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'

WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
),
q2 AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN date_part('quarter', ts) > 2 THEN make_date(CAST(date_part('year', ts) AS INTEGER), 4, 1)
    ELSE make_date(CAST(date_part('year', ts) AS INTEGER) - 1, 4, 1)
  END AS start_ts
  FROM as_of
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN q2
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at >= q2.start_ts
  AND o.completed_at < q2.start_ts + INTERVAL 3 MONTH

WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN as_of
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', as_of.ts) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH
  AND o.completed_at < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', as_of.ts)

WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN as_of
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at > as_of.ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND o.completed_at <= as_of.ts

SELECT c.country, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.country

SELECT c.plan, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.plan

WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
)
SELECT o.channel, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN as_of
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
  AND o.completed_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts)
GROUP BY o.channel

SELECT c.country, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS payments_received
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.failure_code IS NULL
  AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') AS revenue,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE failure_code IS NULL AND paid_at IS NOT NULL) AS payments_received

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_total
FROM customers

WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(created_at), MAX(completed_at)) AS ts FROM orders
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_ordered
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN as_of
WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
  AND o.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of.ts)

SELECT pr.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY pr.category

SELECT st.category, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, category
  FROM support_tickets
) st ON st.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY st.category

SELECT ce.event_type, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, event_type
  FROM checkout_events
) ce ON ce.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY ce.event_type
